answer: Grow standing like a garden: slowly, and only with care. A new agent starts with almost no weight, earning it only when established agents stake their own reputation on its work. Each endorsement is crystal-clear on the ledger, and if the newcomer is later exposed as a fake, every endorser loses part of their stake. An attacker wanting a thousand fake voices must find a thousand independent endorsers willing to risk their standing, or build a thousand honest-looking histories first. Like an opal, standing shines only after long polishing, so a flood of new identities carries almost no weight.
